work_gen_1.intro: Please tell me about your job, duties, likes/dislikes and reasons for changing the job (if any).
work_gen_1.criteria: Professionalism, Sense of Responsibility, Job Satisfaction

work_gen_2.intro: How do you handle pressure or tight deadlines at your workplace?

work_pro_3.intro: Why do you want to leave your current well-paying job to join the Defence Forces?
work_pro_3.expected_points: passion, service over money, adventure, disciplined life

work_pro_4.intro: Describe a situation at your workplace where you took the initiative to solve a critical problem.
work_pro_4.expected_points: proactive approach, problem solving, leadership, impact

work_pro_5.intro: How do you manage your finances? Do you contribute to your family expenses?
work_pro_5.expected_points: financial planning, savings, responsibility towards family

edu_gen_1.intro: Tell me about your education from Class VIII onwards. Which subjects you liked/disliked and why?

edu_gen_2.intro: Tell me about your academic performance starting from 10th class. Mention your favorite subjects and teachers.
edu_gen_2.expected_points: academic consistency, honesty about grades, respect for teachers, clear reasoning for subject choice

edu_gen_3.intro: Why did you choose your specific stream (Science/Arts/Commerce) after 10th class?

edu_fresher_4.intro: You seem to have a gap in your grades during 12th standard. What was the reason?
edu_fresher_4.expected_points: honesty, accepting mistakes, bouncing back, improvement

edu_fresher_5.intro: Who was your favorite teacher in college and why? Also, tell me one teacher you didn't like.
edu_fresher_5.expected_points: respect, objective reasoning, maturity, no bad-mouthing

internship_1.intro: Tell me about the project you handled during your internship. What was your specific role?

internship_2.intro: Did you face any conflict or disagreement with your mentor or peers during your internship? How did you handle it?
internship_2.expected_points: communication, conflict resolution, patience, professional behavior

internship_3.intro: How is the corporate work culture different from your college life based on your internship experience?

family_1.intro: Tell me about your family, your parents' occupation, and how you spend time together.

family_2.intro: Tell me about your relationship with your parents and siblings. Whom are you closest to?
family_2.expected_points: family support, transparency, helping nature, responsibility at home

family_3.intro: How do you spend your weekends? Do you help in household chores?

general_1.intro: How do you spend your spare time? What are your hobbies and interests?
general_1.expected_points: productive use of time, outdoor activities, reading, team games, creativity

general_2.intro: Why do you want to join the Defence Forces despite having other career options?
general_2.expected_points: service to nation, adventure, pride in uniform, disciplined life, not just for money

general_3.intro: Tell me about a situation where you organized an event or a trip with friends.
general_3.expected_points: planning, coordination, handling money, solving sudden problems, leadership

general_4.intro: What are the major headlines in today's newspaper?

pi_intro_special.intro: Please give a brief introduction about yourself.
pi_intro_special.expected_points: name, place, family details, education, achievements, hobbies
pi_intro_special.criteria: Structure check: Name, Origin, Education, Family Background, Hobbies and Achievements.
